# Paul Meyers

> Paul Meyers is an AI Solutions Architect and the founder of PM Consulting Inc., based in North Bay, Ontario, Canada. He helps small businesses, contractors, and home service pros win more work through AI systems, local SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and marketing that gets them found and chosen.

## About

Paul Meyers builds practical AI and marketing systems for owner-operated businesses. His work spans AI operating systems (a business's numbers and workflows on one screen), local SEO and AEO (being found and recommended by Google and AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity), high-converting websites, reputation and review systems, and lead-loss prevention. He is a Claude Partner Network member and runs several brands under PM Consulting Inc.

## Brands and properties

- PM Consulting Inc.: https://pmconsulting.ca (the parent consultancy)
- Contractor Marketing Engine: https://contractormarketingengine.ca (marketing systems for contractors)
- AgentEspresso: https://agentespresso.ca (AI knowledge systems and AI operating systems)
- AI-Employee: https://ai-employee.ca (AI employees for small business)
- Zero Lead Loss: https://zeroleadloss.com (the Lead Loss Audit for contractors)
- PM Consulting Reviews: https://pmconsultingreviews.ca (client reviews and results)

## Who Paul helps

Small businesses and the trades: contractors, home service pros, and local service businesses that want the leverage of AI and modern marketing without hiring an in-house team.
